crossRefs.note: For the thing which I fear comes on me, That which I am afraid of comes to me.
A sound of terrors is in his ears. In prosperity the destroyer will come on him.
but a certain fearful expectation of judgment, and a fierceness of fire which will devour the adversaries.
You have given him his heart’s desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips.
Also delight yourself in Yahweh, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them.
Blessed are those who hunger and thirst after righteousness, for they shall be filled.
I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.
Until now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be made full.
This is the boldness which we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.
And if we know that he listens to us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.

translations.web: What the wicked fear, will overtake them, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.
translations.bsb: What the wicked man dreads will overtake him, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.
translations.kjv: The fear of the wicked, it shall come upon him: but the desire of the righteous shall be granted.
translations.asv: The fear of the wicked, it shall come upon him; And the desire of the righteous shall be granted.
